runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts 180 days after the memorandum is issued. The memorandum covers any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. It also reaches any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The excerpts don't give the exact issuance date. The document is titled "April 2025," so the 180-day mark falls in roughly October 2025, but that is an inference from the title, not a stated date. The memorandum also does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
